description: Synthetic: escrow ids, block hashes, block numbers and indexes are made up. Only the genesis hash is real (faucet GET /chain and tclk/flop/VERIFICATION.md). Escrow c3: clean open and release. Escrow b2: clean open only. Escrow a1: only malformed events (index as a string, short block hash, finalized as a string). Also events whose escrow id does not parse (short id on a finalized release, missing data, a number as id) and one entry that is not an object. Expected: c3, a1 and b2 all unverified. a1 has no well formed event. A finalized release with an unparsable id could be about any escrow: it could be a second distinct release of c3, which is a conflict just as two well formed releases are, and it could be the release of b2.
